cohort: The study included 185 neonates born at 22 and 23 weeks' gestation who were admitted to a single-center neonatal intensive care unit between January 2006 and December 2023.
finding: Death within 72 hours of birth in neonates born at 22-23 weeks gestation is significantly associated with fetal bradycardia, low 5-min Apgar scores, and tension pneumothorax.
mod_finding: In the group experiencing death within 72 hours after birth, differences were observed in the mode of delivery, which was determined by fetal bradycardia in 26.7% of these cases.
